existing.protocol:
Fixed-rhythm LN layout comparison on the existing 14-chart development set.

All source object identities, timestamps, types and raw sound fields must stay
unchanged. These are known development charts, not an unseen player evaluation.
Run before tuning; keep every row, including failures and regressions.
existing.acceptance: Zero non-lane changes and structural errors. Default tight-repress and fast-repeat aggregate must not increase by >max(5,5%). Hybrid/inverse controls must change their intended metric on eligible material. Report all split-release changes and runtime. This does not measure musical quality.

release_control.protocol:
Fixed-rhythm LN layout comparison on the existing 14-chart development set.

All source object identities, timestamps, types and raw sound fields must stay
unchanged. These are known development charts, not an unseen player evaluation.
Run before tuning; keep every row, including failures and regressions.
release_control.acceptance: Zero non-lane changes and structural errors. Default tight-repress and fast-repeat aggregate must not increase by >max(5,5%). Hybrid/inverse controls must change their intended metric on eligible material. Report all split-release changes and runtime. This does not measure musical quality.
